name: Large capacitors
summary: Large capacitors from motors, microwaves and power gear: run and start caps, HV caps and power-factor banks.
uses: Replacing a dead AC motor, pump or compressor capacitor
Running an induction motor as a generator (with the right capacitors)
identify: Metal or plastic cylinders with two or three spade terminals, marked in µF and volts (for example 35/5 µF 440V), on AC units, pumps, fans and compressors. The microwave HV capacitor is a flat metal can near the transformer and can kill hours after unplugging. Old oil-filled capacitors (before about 1980) may hold toxic PCB oil.
test: Discharge first with an insulated resistor tool, then use a meter’s capacitance range: it should read within about 6% of the label. Bulging, leaking or cracked cans are dead.

decay.note: Film and oil types last decades; electrolytic start capacitors dry out sooner.
